body:
### Description

We observe intermittent, non-deterministic incorrect results from a jax.custom_jvp-wrapped function called inside jax.vmap. The failure:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  - Happens in a single sequential process (no threading/multiprocessing)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  - Occurs ~30% of runs of the same deterministic code                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
  - Produces a result that is exactly 2.0 too large every time it fails — not floating-point noise                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  - Is triggered by evaluating certain combinations of custom pytree objects earlier in the same process                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
  - Affects the imaginary part of the log-normalizer under complex inputs, systematically shifting Im(log φ(t)) = η·t to (η+2)·t across all 300 evaluation points                                                                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
The consistent +2 offset (rather than random noise) suggests a JIT cache or compiled kernel selection error rather than a floating-point summation issue.                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
Reproducer: Requires the efax library. Full notes [here](https://github.com/NeilGirdhar/efax/blob/cd1781359a32e2c165631338abf77cce6d263d74/.claude/memory/flaky_tests.md) Minimal test sequence:
```fish
  for i in (seq 50)                                         
      if pytest \                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
        "tests/test_ep_from_cf.py::test_ep_from_cf[Bernoulli]" \
        "tests/test_ep_from_cf.py::test_ep_from_cf[Exponential]" \                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
        "tests/test_ep_from_cf.py::test_ep_from_cf[InverseGaussian]" \
        "tests/test_ep_from_cf.py::test_ep_from_cf[UnitVarianceLogNormal]" \                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   
        --dist=no -q -p no:randomly                                         
          echo "pass $i"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
      else                                                  
          echo "FAILED on run $i"; break                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
      end                                                   
  end
```

I'm working a better MWE, but would appreciate any ideas about what might be going wrong.
